products.name: DataHop
products.tagline: Send files device to device. No cloud, no accounts.
products.description: DataHop opens an encrypted WebRTC channel straight between two devices. Your files never touch a server, there is no size limit, and nobody has to sign up for anything.
features: Files move directly between devices. They never reach our servers.
Send a 40 GB folder as easily as a screenshot. No upload, no queue.
Peers on the same network pair automatically, or scan a QR code.

products.name: Download Manager
products.tagline: Saturate your connection. Survive any crash.
products.description: A Rust download engine that splits every file across parallel streams and checkpoints as it goes. Pull the plug mid-download and it picks up exactly where it stopped.
features: Memory-safe and highly concurrent, so network I/O is never the bottleneck.
Every file is split across parallel HTTP streams to max out your line.
A power cut or a dropped connection costs you nothing. Resume and continue.

products.name: AsoltuRemote
products.tagline: Your desktop, from anywhere, in under a megabyte.
products.description: A tiny desktop agent for Windows and macOS plus an iOS client. Low-latency control, secure signalling, and file transfer between the machines you actually use.
features: Mouse and keyboard input translated across platforms without the lag.
Move files between host and client without a second tool.
Authenticated over secure signalling servers. Nothing is left open.

products.name: PDF-O
products.tagline: Scan, edit and compress documents on your iPhone.
products.description: Turn your camera into a scanner, run OCR over what you capture, then edit, sign and compress the result — all on device.

builds.requires: iPhone and iPad, iOS 15 or later

features: Search inside a scanned page the moment you capture it.
Cut a 40 MB scan down to a few megabytes without turning it to mush.
Reorder pages, annotate, and drop in a signature before you send.

products.name: i2Droid
products.tagline: Bridge your iPhone and your Android devices.
products.description: The Hopp project. Move files and data across the ecosystem boundary over your local network, without a cloud round-trip in the middle.

builds.requires: iPhone and iPad, iOS 15 or later

features: iPhone to Android and back, without emailing files to yourself.
Local transfers that never leave the room, let alone the country.

products.name: Asoltu
products.tagline: Every Indian competitive exam, practised in one app.
products.description: Chapterwise and full-length mock tests for RPSC, REET, SSC, UPSC and ICAI, with the most secure live test system we have built.

builds.requires: iPhone and iPad, iOS 15 or later

features: Real exam conditions, with the anti-cheat that live testing needs.
Scores, accuracy and completion, subject by subject, over time.
